```{r}
## ---- Load required libraries ----------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(here)

## ---- Input file ------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

## ---- Build presence/absence sets for each host group ----
df_sets_timepoints <- df %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%                           # keep only present vOTUs
  mutate(group = case_when(
    bodysite == "breastmilk"                                   ~ "Breastmilk",
    mother_infant == "mother"  & bodysite == "stool"           ~ "Mother_stool",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25       ~ "Infant_1W",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1          ~ "Infant_1M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6          ~ "Infant_6M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12         ~ "Infant_12M",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%                   # remove unclassified
  select(vOTUs, subject, group) %>%            # only relevant columns
  distinct() %>%                               # remove duplicates
  group_by(vOTUs, group) %>%
  summarise(present = 1, .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0                           # presence/absence matrix
  )

## ---- Palette timepoint colors ----------------------------
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Infant_1W"    = "blue",
  "Infant_1M"    = "darkgreen",
  "Infant_6M"    = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Infant_12M"   = "gold",
  "Mother_stool" = "purple4",
  "Breastmilk"   = "pink"
)

## ---- Themes: clean, and NO axis numbers only in intersections ----

upset_themes_clean <- list(
  intersections_matrix = theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),   # ← ONLY modification
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    ),
  intersections_matrix_sizes = theme_bw(),   # keep default
  overall_sizes              = theme_bw()    # keep default
)

## ---- Create the UpSet plot ------------------------------
p <- upset(
  df_sets_timepoints,
  intersect = names(timepoint_colors),
  name = "vOTUs",
  min_size = 10,
  width_ratio = 0.3,

  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = intersection_size(
      text = list(size = 3)
    )
  ),

  # Color highlighting for each group
  queries = lapply(names(timepoint_colors), function(grp) {
    upset_query(
      intersect       = grp,
      fill            = timepoint_colors[[grp]],
      color           = timepoint_colors[[grp]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  }),

  themes = upset_themes_clean
)

print(p)

## ---- Save plot -------------------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "Figure1")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "UpSet_all_vOTUs_timepoints.png"),
  plot     = p,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300
)

```

```{r}
# ¿Cómo se distribuye el core infantil (85%) entre los cuatro timepoints del bebé?”

library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

theme_set(theme_bw())  # tema limpio

# 1. Cargar datos
df <- read_csv(
  "~/Escritorio/MAMI_Paper_2024/final_table/FINAL_TABLE_ALL/FINAL_data_forplots_CPMs_RPMs_newmetadata.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 2. Crear columna de grupo general
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Group_general = case_when(
    mother_infant == "infant" ~ "Infant",
    grepl("BM", Sample)       ~ "Breastmilk",
    mother_infant == "mother" ~ "Mother_stool",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_general))

# 3. Core del viroma infantil (85%)
core_votus <- df %>%
  filter(Group_general == "Infant") %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(total_cpm = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cpm)) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_cpm  = cumsum(total_cpm),
    cum_perc = cum_cpm / sum(total_cpm) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(cum_perc <= 85) %>%
  pull(vOTUs)

# 4. Grupo detallado por tiempo
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Group_detailed = case_when(
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "Infant_1W",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1.00 ~ "Infant_1M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6.00 ~ "Infant_6M",
    mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12.00 ~ "Infant_12M",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_detailed))

# 5. Solo vOTUs del core
df_core <- df %>%
  filter(vOTUs %in% core_votus)

# 6. Matriz de presencia
presence_matrix <- df_core %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%
  mutate(presence = 1) %>%
  select(vOTUs, Group_detailed, presence) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group_detailed, values_from = presence, values_fill = 0)

# 7. Asegurar 711 vOTUs
presence_matrix <- presence_matrix %>%
  right_join(tibble(vOTUs = core_votus), by = "vOTUs") %>%
  mutate(across(-vOTUs, ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))

# 8. Asegurar columnas
grupos <- c("Infant_1W", "Infant_1M", "Infant_6M", "Infant_12M")
for (g in grupos) {
  if (!(g %in% colnames(presence_matrix))) {
    presence_matrix[[g]] <- 0
  }
}

# 9. Colores
color_map <- c(
  "Infant_1W"  = "blue", 
  "Infant_1M"  = "darkgreen", 
  "Infant_6M"  = "mediumaquamarine", 
  "Infant_12M" = "gold"
)

# 10. UpSet plot
plot_upset <- upset(
  presence_matrix,
  intersect = grupos,
  name = "Presence of dominant phage infant vOTUs",
  min_size = 1,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Shared vOTUs' = intersection_size(text = list(size = 3.5))
  ),
  queries = lapply(grupos, function(grp) {
    upset_query(
      intersect       = grp,
      fill            = color_map[[grp]],
      color           = color_map[[grp]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  }),
  width_ratio = 0.3
)

print(plot_upset)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

IN <- "~/Escritorio/MAMI_Paper_2024/final_table/FINAL_TABLE_ALL/FINAL_data_forplots_CPMs_RPMs_newmetadata.csv"
df <- read_csv(IN, show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- Definir grupos (Infant por TP, Mother, Milk) ---
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "Breastmilk",
      mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "Mother_stool",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "Infant_1W",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1    ~ "Infant_1M",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6    ~ "Infant_6M",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12   ~ "Infant_12M",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))

groups6 <- c("Infant_1W","Infant_1M","Infant_6M","Infant_12M","Mother_stool","Breastmilk")

# --- Presencia/ausencia por vOTU x grupo (presente si CPM>0 en ≥1 muestra del grupo) ---
presence_mat <- df %>%
  group_by(vOTUs, group) %>%
  summarise(present = as.integer(any(CPM > 0, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

# Asegurar columnas
for (g in groups6) if (!(g %in% colnames(presence_mat))) presence_mat[[g]] <- 0L
presence_mat <- presence_mat %>% select(vOTUs, all_of(groups6))

# --- Colapsar Infant_any + Mother + Milk (esto fuerza SOLO tus 7 categorías) ---
presence_comp <- presence_mat %>%
  mutate(
    Infant_any = pmax(Infant_1W, Infant_1M, Infant_6M, Infant_12M),
    Mother = Mother_stool,
    Milk   = Breastmilk
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    vOTUs,
    Infant = as.integer(Infant_any == 1),
    Mother = as.integer(Mother == 1),
    Milk   = as.integer(Milk == 1)
  )

# 🔑 AQUÍ EL CAMBIO
presence_comp <- presence_comp %>%
  rename(`Human milk` = Milk)


# (Opcional) comprobar que los conteos coinciden con tu tabla
category_counts <- presence_comp %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    Mother == 1 & `Human milk` == 0 & Infant == 0 ~ "Mother only",
    Infant == 1 & Mother == 0 & `Human milk` == 0 ~ "Infant only",
    Infant == 1 & Mother == 1 & `Human milk` == 0 ~ "Infant + Mother only",
    `Human milk` == 1 & Mother == 0 & Infant == 0 ~ "Human milk only",
    Infant == 1 & `Human milk` == 1 & Mother == 0 ~ "Infant + Human milk only",
    Infant == 1 & Mother == 1 & `Human milk` == 1 ~ "Infant + Mother + Human milk",
    Mother == 1 & `Human milk` == 1 & Infant == 0 ~ "Mother + Human milk only",
    TRUE ~ "None"
  )) %>%
  count(category, name = "n_vOTUs") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_vOTUs))

print(category_counts)

# --- UpSet plot SOLO con esas intersecciones (3 sets) ---
sets_comp <- c("Infant","Mother","Human milk")
set_colors <- c("Infant" = "gold", "Mother" = "purple4", "Human milk" = "pink")

p <- upset(
  presence_comp,
  intersect = sets_comp,
  name = "vOTUs",
  min_size = 1,  # importante: para que salga Mother+Milk only (=3) y otros pequeños
  sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
  width_ratio = 0.33,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Intersection size" = intersection_size(text = list(size = 3))
  ),
  queries = lapply(sets_comp, function(s) {
    upset_query(
      intersect = s,
      fill = set_colors[[s]],
      color = set_colors[[s]],
      only_components = "intersections_matrix"
    )
  })
)

print(p)

# --- Guardar PDF ---
out_pdf <- "~/Escritorio/MAMI_Paper_2024/FINAL_FIGURES/transmission/upset_compartments_only_these7.pdf"
ggsave(out_pdf, p, device = cairo_pdf, width = 11, height = 6, units = "in")
```
